answer: Zenith no longer auto-retries a mid-turn failure by resending the full transcript — that used to duplicate side effects (e.g., re-running `git commit`) because a resend isn't idempotent once a `tool_use` block has actually executed. Since your laptop was untouched (no input, likely asleep or idle the whole time), it was polling at the slowest interval, so it could take up to 15 minutes (or longer if it was asleep and only reset on resume) to pick up the change.
